about.title: Yini isethi yeMandelbrot
about.lede: Kuyinto eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kwizibalo, futhi ikhiqizwa umugqa owodwa wezibalo ingane engayilandela. Leli khasi likhuluma ngokuthi kungani lokho kuyinqaba.
about.rule.heading: Umthetho owodwa, ophindaphindiwe
about.rule.p1: Khetha iphoyinti endizeni eyisicaba. Sikwele, engeza iphuzu oqale ngalo, futhi usunephuzu elisha. Sikwele lokho, engeza okwangempela futhi, futhi uqhubeke unomphela.
about.rule.p2: Zimbili izinto ezingenzeka. Amaphuzu angase azulazule futhi angaphinde abuye, agijimele okungapheli. Noma bangase bahlale eduze nasekhaya kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uqhubeka isikhathi eside kangakanani. Isethi ye-Mandelbrot imane iyiqoqo lamaphuzu okuqala ahlala.
about.rule.p3: Yileyo ncazelo yonke. Isifunda esimnyama kuzo zonke izithombe kule sayithi yisethi ngokwayo;
about.surprise.heading: Akekho oklame umumo
about.surprise.p1: Umthetho awuqukethe imibuthano, akukho spirals, akukho seahorses, akukho umbani. Kuwukuphindaphinda kanye nokwengeza. Konke okubonayo kwase kuvele kushiwo yilezo zinqubo ezimbili, zilindele ukuthi kube khona ozoyihlela.
about.surprise.p2: Le ngxenye ephazamisa abantu abahlangana nayo ngendlela efanele. Umumo awusungulwanga futhi awukwazi ukulungiswa. Shintsha umthetho bese uthola into ehlukile, hhayi inguqulo ebukeka kangcono yale. Yonke imininingwane iphoqelelwe.
about.boundary.heading: Unqenqema alulokothi luxazulule
about.boundary.p1: Izimo eziningi ziba lula njengoba ubheka eduze. Umbuthano okhuliswe ngokwanele awuhlukaniseki emugqeni oqondile. Unqenqema lwesethi ye-Mandelbrot yenza okuphambene: konke ukukhuliswa kwembula isakhiwo esasingabonakali ngaphambili, futhi kwenza kanjalo ngaphandle kokuphela.
about.boundary.p2: Ingaphakathi lijwayelekile ngokwanele ukukala - indawo yalo icishe ibe ngu-1.506. Umngcele awukho. Ngo-1998 u-Mitsuhiro Shishikura wafakazela ukuthi inohlangothi 2 lwe-fractal, okuyindlela enembayo yokusho ukuthi ijika elingenakho ukujiya liyakwazi ukuminyana njengendawo egcwele.
about.copies.heading: Amakhophi alo lonke, kodwa angalokothi neze
about.copies.p1: Sondeza emngceleni noma yikuphi futhi ekugcineni kuvela isiqhingi esincane esimnyama, ngokusobala isimo esifanayo oqale ngaso. Lawa ajwayele ukubizwa ngama-minibrots, futhi maningi ngokungenamkhawulo, kuzo zonke izikali, kuye phansi.
about.copies.p2: Akuwona amakhophi aqondile. Ngayinye ihlanekezelwe, futhi ngayinye igoqwe endaweni ezungezile - ama-spirals, ama-filaments, amaketanga eziqhingi ezincane - okungeyaleyo ndawo futhi ayikho enye. Isethi iphinda itimu yayo ngaphandle kokuziphinda.
about.atlas.heading: Kuyinkomba yeminye imihlaba
about.atlas.p1: Sebenzisa umthetho ofanayo kodwa ubambe iphuzu elengeziwe lilungiswe, futhi uthola into ehlukile ebizwa ngokuthi isethi kaJulia. Kunephuzu elilodwa kuwo wonke amaphoyinti endizeni, futhi asukela kwizihibe ezihlanzekile ezixhunyiwe kuya othulini olunqanyuliwe.
about.atlas.p2: Isethi yeMandelbrot kuvela ukuthi iyimephu okuyiyona yona. Iphuzu ngaphakathi kwalo lihambisana ne-Julia ehlelwe esiqeshini esisodwa; Kuyisithombe esisodwa esiklelisa umndeni ongapheli wabanye, futhi akekho obeka leyo ndawo lapho ngenhloso.
about.discovery.heading: Kwatholakala, akwenziwanga
about.discovery.p1: Isithombe sokuqala esaziwayo sanyatheliswa nguRobert Brooks noPeter Matelski ngo-1978. U-Benoit Mandelbrot, osebenza kwa-IBM, wakhiqiza izithombe ngo-1980 futhi waqaphela ukuthi wayebhekeni;
about.discovery.p2: Izibalo ezingemuva kwayo zindala namanje, zibuyela ku-Pierre Fatou no-Gaston Julia cishe ngo-1918, owafunda lokhu kuphindaphinda amashumi eminyaka ngaphambi kokuba kube khona umshini ongakhipha imiphumela. Babecabanga ngesimo okungekho noyedwa kubo owayeyoke asibone.
about.discovery.p3: Noma ubani, noma yikuphi, osebenzisa umthetho ofanayo uthola into efanayo kuze kufike emculweni wokugcina. Ngalowo mqondo awuzange udalwe ngo-1980. Kwatholakala khona.
about.scale.heading: Kude kangakanani lokhu
about.scale.p1: Izithombe lapha zifinyelela ekukhulisweni okungaba ngu-10⁴¹. Uma isethi yonke ibidwetshwe kuleso sikali esikrinini esiyimitha ububanzi, isikrini bekuyodingeka sibe ububanzi ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingamakhulu ezinkulungwane zezigidigidi kunomkhathi obonakalayo ukuze sisibambe.
about.scale.p2: Ayikho kuleyo mininingwane egcinwe noma kuphi. Ibalwa ngokufunwa, kusukela emthethweni ofanayo womugqa owodwa, njalo uma ubheka. Asikho isithombe esiyisisekelo esikhuliswayo - kukhona i-arithmetic kuphela, futhi iqhubeka unomphela.
about.explore.heading: Hamba uyobheka
about.explore.p1: Hudula ukuze uhambise, skrola ukuze usondeze. Ithebhu Yezindawo inesethi yezindawo okufanele zibonwe, okuhlanganisa isiqhingi esijulile esihlala izindawo zamadesimali ezingamashumi amane nambili phansi. Yonke into oyitholayo ikubha yekheli, ngakho-ke noma yikuphi ukubuka kungabiwa njengesixhumanisi.
ui.title: Mandelbrot
ui.hint.drag: Hudula uye pan, skrola ukuze usondeze. I-URL ihlezi iphethe isimo esigcwele.
ui.hint.gamma: Ukuxuba i-Palette nokukhanyisa kugijima ekukhanyeni komugqa;
ui.error.stopped: Ukunikezwa kumisiwe. Lokhu ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi umshayeli wezithombe wayeka uhlaka oluthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Yehlisa isibalo sokuphindaphinda bese ulayisha kabusha ikhasi.
ui.notice.noWebgpu: Lesi siphequluli asisebenzisi i-WebGPU, ngakho-ke isinikezeli sibuyele emuva ku-WebGL2, ephelelwa ukunemba ekusondezeni okungashoni kakhulu.
ui.notice.enableFlag: Uma isiphequluli sakho sisekela i-WebGPU kodwa singayisebenzisi, vula i-chrome://flags, setha okuthi Khipha uhlu lokunikeza isofthiwe kokuthi Kunikwe amandla, bese uqala kabusha isiphequluli. Ikhasi elithi chrome://gpu lichaza ukuthi kungani lenqatshiwe.
